text:
Riley: Quick poll  Post-game tailgate at the office or rooftop tonight? finals are on and my place is tiny.
Maya: Office kitchen! snacks + projector. I can bring sliders.
Owen: Rooftop sounds amazing if weather holds. anyone bringing a speaker?
Priya M: I vote office — easier for transit and no risk of rain. Also: can we avoid spoilers for the West conference stream? some teammates are watching later.
Riley: Good point about spoilers. We'll mute score updates in #random if we go rooftop.
Maya: Also fantasy note: if anyone wants to swap bench players before tomorrow's lineup lock DM me, I have an extra waiver spot up for trade.
Owen: I'm torn between bringing wings or a salad. wings get my vote.
Priya M: Wings. Also put a tiny table for trivia between quarters? small prizes = pride.
Riley: Poll: Office kitchen (yes/no). leaguebot: created poll "Office kitchen tailgate?" voting open 6h.
leaguebot: votes recorded: Maya yes, Priya M yes, Owen no. 2/3 so far.
Maya: If office wins I'll bring sliders + napkins. Owen you bring drinks?
Owen: Deal. I'll bring soda and beer.
Riley: Okay office it is unless more objections. I'll reserve the projector and post final logistics at 18:00. No spoilers rule in #random until tomorrow 11:00.
Priya M: Thanks! Also someone remind me to set keeper declarations next week, totally forgot.
Maya: Reminder set for 7 days before draft in the calendar.
Riley: Party at 7pm. See y'all there :tada:
